title: Metagenomic extraction of high molecular weight plankton from filters
author: Benoît Vacherie
materials: Successive filtration on 3 filters of different porosities: 20 µm; 3 µm; 0.2 µm. Nylon Net filter 20 µm Merck Millipore (EMD Millipore) Catalog #NY2004700 isopore membrane filter 3 µm Merck Millipore (EMD Millipore) Catalog #TSTP04700 Isopore membrane filter 0.2 µm Merck Millipore (EMD Millipore) Catalog #GTTP04700

steps.title: Filter Water Samples
steps.instruction: Perform cascade filtration of several liters of fresh or sea water using a peristaltic pump (e.g., Spectra Field Pro, SFP-100).

substeps.instruction: Pre-filter through a 100µm cellular sieve (e.g., Falcon 352360) to remove large debris and larger zooplanktonic organisms.

steps.title: Store Filters
steps.instruction: Preserve the filters for later extraction using one of two methods.

substeps.instruction: Method 1: Transfer filters into 5 ml tubes, flash freeze in liquid nitrogen, and store at -80°C.
Method 2: Resuspend filters directly in NucleoProtect RNA (Macherey-Nagal Catalog #740400.500) and store at 4°C.

steps.title: Recover Organisms from Filters
steps.instruction: Extract organisms from the filter membrane and pellet them.

substeps.instruction: Add 3 ml of 1X PBS to the tube containing the filter.
Vortex at maximum power to loosen organisms from the membrane.
Remove the filter using sterile forceps.
Centrifuge the tube at 5000 x g for 5 minutes at room temperature to pellet the organisms.
Gently remove the supernatant with a pipette.
If filters were stored in Nucleoprotect, perform a second wash using 500 µl of 1X PBS and repeat the centrifugation step.

steps.title: Grind Organisms
steps.instruction: Lyse and mechanically grind the recovered organisms using the DNeasy PowerSoil Pro Kit (Qiagen Catalog #47014).

substeps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in 800 µl of CD1 buffer.
Incubate for 10 minutes at 65 °C with 300 rpm agitation.
Transfer the suspension to a PowerBeads tube.
Vortex at maximum speed for 3 cycles of 1 minute each, with a 1-minute pause between cycles, using a horizontal tube adapter.
Transfer the grinding material into a 2ml tube by dipping the tip to the bottom of the tube.

steps.title: Perform PowerSoil Extraction
steps.instruction: Extract DNA using the PowerSoil kit reagents and spin columns.

substeps.instruction: Add 200 µl of CD2 solution (stored at 4°C) to the grinding material, vortex for 5 seconds, and centrifuge at 14,000 x g for 1 minute at room temperature.
Transfer the supernatant to a 2ml tube (avoiding the pellet), add 600 µl of CD3 solution, and vortex for 5 seconds.
Load 700 µl of the lysate onto an MB spin column and centrifuge at 14,000 x g for 1 minute at room temperature.
Discard the filtrate and repeat the loading process until all lysate is consumed.
Place the column in a new collection tube, add 500 µl of EA Solution, and centrifuge at 14,000 x g for 1 minute at room temperature.
Discard the filtrate, add 500 µl of Solution C5, and centrifuge at 14,000 x g for 1 minute at room temperature.
Place the column in a new collection tube and centrifuge at 14,000 x g for 2 minutes at room temperature.

steps.title: Elute DNA
steps.instruction: Elute the DNA from the spin column using Solution C6.

substeps.instruction: Place the column in a 1.5 ml Eppendorf tube.
Add 25 µl of Solution C6 to the center of the column.
Incubate for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Centrifuge at 14,000 x g for 1 minute at room temperature.
Repeat the addition of 25 µl of Solution C6, 5-minute incubation, and 1-minute centrifugation at 14,000 x g.
Remove the column.

steps.title: Quality Control and Storage
steps.instruction: Verify the extracted DNA and store the sample.

substeps.instruction: Measure concentration using Qbit.
Measure purity using Nanodrop.
Estimate molecule size using TapeStation or Femto-pulse.
Store the tube at -20°C.
